posts.description: It’s Monday morning. I woke up, checked my phone, got dressed, and walked out of my room. Mom was having breakfast at the table. She looked up. “Why are you up so early today?”, sounding confused. “I’m going to Grandma’s.” Dad appeared behind me. “I’ll take you there,” he said.
